text.tspan: MAIN WIRING · one controller at the centre · one conductor per route
Selected controller build: follow each named terminal and match every route ID to the evidence list below.
DOTTED = GUESS / proposed wire; verify before connecting
OPEN = no connection until the missing evidence is obtained
Crossing lines are not junctions. Only named terminal circles are connection points. Repeated controller labels are contact references, not extra physical pins.
Selected machine retrofit · individual contact references

C05-001 · Hotend temperature candidate · Identify thermistor/PT100/PT1000 part number and match ADC configuration/amplifier; no sensor type inferred.
C05-002 · Hotend sensor return · Only if sensor topology is compatible and actual harness contacts are traced.
C06-001 · Bed temperature candidate · Identify thermistor/PT100/PT1000 part number and match ADC configuration/amplifier; no sensor type inferred.
C06-002 · Bed sensor return · Only if sensor topology is compatible and actual harness contacts are traced.
C07-001 · heater-load supply to Prime VFET rail · Use only after measuring bed voltage/current and selecting the correct fuse, connector, and supply capacity.
C07-002 · heater-load return supply · Confirm exact power-supply return and protective/logic-ground strategy.
C07-003 · shared VFET bed-supply net · Exact P12 schematic/netlist shows both connector contacts on VFET.

text.tspan: C07-003 · internal factory net · not a fitted wire

g.title: C07-004 · bed heater positive feed · Dotted machine endpoint until actual bed voltage, current and harness cavity are identified.
C07-005 · bed heater switched return · Dotted machine endpoint; confirm heater channel configuration, current and thermal protections.
C08-001 · candidate SPI chip select to Pmod SS · Core J36.6 is PD15 candidate CS; verify firmware CS mapping.
C08-002 · SPI1 COPI to MAX31865 MOSI · Confirm Core pin nets/logic levels and firmware driver.
C08-003 · MAX31865 MISO to SPI1 CIPO · Confirm direction/logic levels on exact board revision.
C08-004 · SPI clock to MAX31865 SCLK · Confirm firmware SPI configuration and timing.
C08-005 · digital ground reference · J36.10 is GND; verify 3.3V logic reference.
C08-006 · RTD lead A to CON1.1 FORCE+ · Use measured two-wire PT100 terminals; J2 jumper bridges FORCE+ with RTDIN+.
C08-007 · RTD lead B to CON1.4 FORCE− · Use measured two-wire PT100 terminals; J2 jumper bridges FORCE− with RTDIN−.
C08-008 · 3.3V module supply to Pmod VCC pin6 · Verify Core 3V3 power budget and J5.10 rating; module data sheet identifies J1.6 as +3.3V.
C08-009 · 3.3V module supply to Pmod VCC pin12 · J1.12 is a second Pmod +3.3V contact; use the same verified host 3V3 rail.
C08-010 · Pmod secondary GND contact pin11 · ADI data sheet identifies J1.11 as GND; tie to the same verified signal return.
C08-011 · Fit 2-wire PT100 jumper J2.1–2 · ADI PMB1 Rev0 user guide requires both jumpers for 2-wire mode; jumper is fitted on the module, not a cable to an RTD screw terminal.
C08-012 · Fit 2-wire PT100 jumper J2.3–4 · ADI PMB1 Rev0 user guide requires both jumpers for 2-wire mode; jumper is fitted on the module, not a cable to an RTD screw terminal.
C09-001 · Core 3.3V to PMB1 VCC contact J1.6 · Verify Core J5.10 is an available output with enough current budget for module.
C09-002 · Core 3.3V to duplicate PMB1 VCC contact J1.12 · Same supply net contact, confirm Pmod board revision.
C09-003 · Core return to PMB1 GND J1.5 · Verify actual J5.19 GND net on board export.
C09-004 · Core return to PMB1 GND J1.11 · Same Pmod ground net, keep a low-impedance return.
C10-001 · X endstop signal · Trace actual cable, sensor output, NO/NC and level before assigning; J-number-to-axis is only a candidate.
C10-002 · X endstop return · Verify common/return; selector pin must stay open until voltage requirement is known.
C11-001 · Y endstop signal · Trace actual cable, sensor output, NO/NC and level before assigning; J-number-to-axis is only a candidate.
C11-002 · Y endstop return · Verify common/return; selector pin must stay open until voltage requirement is known.
C12-001 · Z endstop signal · Trace actual cable, sensor output, NO/NC and level before assigning; J-number-to-axis is only a candidate.
C12-002 · Z endstop return · Verify common/return; selector pin must stay open until voltage requirement is known.

C13-001 · Prime regulated logic supply · Prime alternative only. Confirm fitted P11/P12 revision, input-voltage/current limits, supply sequencing and fuse/conductor ratings. Never connect both Core external drivers and Prime winding outputs to the same motor.

C13-002 · Prime logic supply return · Prime alternative only. Confirm fitted P11/P12 revision, input-voltage/current limits, supply sequencing and fuse/conductor ratings. Never connect both Core external drivers and Prime winding outputs to the same motor.

C13-003 · Protected motor branch input · Prime alternative only. Confirm fitted P11/P12 revision, input-voltage/current limits, supply sequencing and fuse/conductor ratings. Never connect both Core external drivers and Prime winding outputs to the same motor.

C13-004 · Prime VMOT power · Prime alternative only. Confirm fitted P11/P12 revision, input-voltage/current limits, supply sequencing and fuse/conductor ratings. Never connect both Core external drivers and Prime winding outputs to the same motor.

C13-005 · Prime motor supply return · Prime alternative only. Confirm fitted P11/P12 revision, input-voltage/current limits, supply sequencing and fuse/conductor ratings. Never connect both Core external drivers and Prime winding outputs to the same motor.
C14-001 · Heater branch fuse feed · Select fuse DC voltage/current/interrupt rating and conductor protection from actual heater/supply.
C14-002 · VFET power entry · Use XT30 J12, not small 2.54mm J11 auxiliary header; verify exact board, connector, PCB and load current limits.
C14-003 · Heater power return · Separate from logic supply/VMOT; verify return topology and protective earth as applicable.
C14-004 · Positive heater feed · J17.1 is downstream of factory Q25 high-side cutoff. Match heater voltage/current and output connector rating.
C14-005 · Thermally protected heater feed · Install rated cutoff mechanically/electrically according to its manufacturer and heater location.
C14-006 · Hotend A switched heater return · J17.2 is Q19 drain; configured output, tested startup-off and validated temperature feedback are mandatory before enabling heat.
C15-001 · Fan1 positive feed · Fan receives VFET rail, not a separately inferred 5V/12V supply. Match actual fan voltage/current.
C15-002 · Fan1 switched return · Q21 internal low-side stage; configure fan function and prove cooling whenever heater is enabled.
C15-003 · Fan2 positive feed · Connect only if fitted or deliberately added, electrically matched and firmware configured.
C15-004 · Fan2 switched return · Q22 internal low-side stage; verify rated load and startup state.

C16-001 · Retained display compatibility · Stock manual pp.11–16 names display, rotary input, SD printing and USB firmware update. MakeICT modified machine does not publish its retained panel wiring. Select a Prime-supported display/host workflow or identify exact panel protocol and connector before retaining it; debug UART is not an assumed panel adapter.
